name: Florida
overview: Homestead exemptions and additional locally adopted senior relief are the principal residential relief identified.

programs.name: Homestead exemption
programs.maximumBenefit: 2025: $25,000 base assessed-value exemption; additional non-school exemption up to $25,722.
programs.formulaSummary: Exempts portions of qualifying assessed value; school and non-school levies differ.
programs.application: Apply through the county property appraiser.
eligibilityNotes: Permanent-residence, ownership, and January 1 qualification rules apply.
interactions: Save Our Homes assessment limits operate separately.

programs.name: Additional senior homestead exemptions
programs.incomeDefinition: Household adjusted gross income; annually adjusted limit.
programs.incomeLimits: Annual state income threshold; local adoption also required.
programs.maximumBenefit: Local non-school assessed-value exemptions, including an up-to-$50,000 option.
programs.formulaSummary: Applies only to the adopting county or municipal levy.
programs.application: Apply through the county property appraiser. A first-time claim requires a sworn household-income statement by March 1 under section 196.075(4)(d).

sources.title: Florida Statutes section 196.075(4)(d): first-time senior exemption claim

researchNotes: The listed Florida programs cover homeowner value exemptions; they do not include a statewide renter or cash circuit-breaker credit.
Tax savings from exempt assessed value depend on the covered tax rates.

sources.title: Florida Statutes section 196.075(4)(d): first-time senior exemption claim
